Name: Junimo and Bird Animation Lamp (SDV1.6)
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[size=4][quote]This mod is a conversion and modification to the FF and CP version of a mod that was previously released as a mod that works with DGA. (Repealed [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14736]DGA version﻿﻿[/url]﻿﻿)
If an older version of DGA is installed, please delete that file.[/quote][/size]
The little bird and Junimo are asleep when placed.
Click to wake them up. (Lights up & animation)

By default, it is sold randomly at Robin's Shop.
Alternatively, all types can be obtained from the furniture catalog.

You can customize various settings using ModConfig.


Currently, English and Japanese translation files are included.


[color=#00ff00][size=3]Regarding the "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]" version.
[/size][/color]Compared to the FF version, some features are restricted.
Since it is set as an alternative texture for the country lamp, there is no action to turn the lamp on or off.
Additionally, it will appear on top of one of the tiles where the light source is placed. (This is also an unavoidable design feature, as all original lamps have a height of two tiles.)
…therefore, the FF version is recommended for use.
